svg.title: Three orbital planes inclined at 50 degrees
svg.desc: An orthographic view of Earth, its three coordinate axes and equator, and three circular orbits. Each orbital plane is inclined 50 degrees to the equatorial plane; their ascending nodes are separated by 60 degrees.
svg.text: Ω: right ascension of ascending node
